arxiv-2203-07762.title: Rigidity of complex projective spaces in Ricci shrinkers
arxiv-2203-07762.creator: Yu Li, and, Wenjia Zhang
arxiv-2203-07762.description: Abstract In this paper, we prove that any Ricci shrinker that is sufficiently close to ( ℂ ​ P N , g F ​ S ) (\mathbb{C}\text{P}^{N},g_{FS}) in the Gromov-Hausdorff sense must itself be isometric to ( ℂ ​ P N , g F ​ S ) (\mathbb{C}\text{P}^{N},g_{FS}) .

arxiv-2307-12985.title: Negative binomial count splitting for single-cell RNA sequencing data
arxiv-2307-12985.creator: Anna Neufeld, Joshua Popp, Lucy L. Gao, Alexis Battle, Daniela Witten
arxiv-2307-12985.description: Abstract The analysis of single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data often involves fitting a latent variable model to learn a low-dimensional representation for the cells. Validating such a model poses a major challenge. If we could sequence the same set of cells twice, we could use one dataset to fit a latent variable model and the other to validate it.

arxiv-2311-16452.title: Can Generalist Foundation Models Outcompete Special-Purpose Tuning? Case Study in Medicine
arxiv-2311-16452.creator: Harsha Nori *‡, Yin Tat Lee *, Sheng Zhang *, Dean Carignan, Richard Edgar, Nicolo Fusi, Nicholas King, Jonathan Larson, Yuanzhi Li, Weishung Liu, Renqian Luo, Scott Mayer McKinney †, Robert Osazuwa Ness, Hoifung Poon, Tao Qin, Naoto Usuyama, Chris White, Eric Horvitz ‡
arxiv-2311-16452.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Harsha Nori *‡, Yin Tat Lee *, Sheng Zhang *, Dean Carignan, Richard Edgar, Nicolo Fusi, Nicholas King, Jonathan Larson, Yuanzhi Li, Weishung Liu, Renqian Luo, Scott Mayer McKinney †, Robert Osazuwa Ness, Hoifung Poon, Tao Qin, Naoto Usuyama, Chris White, Eric Horvitz ‡. Generalist foundation models such as GPT-4 have displayed surprising capabilities in a wide variety of domains and tasks. Yet, there is a prevalent assumption that they cannot match specialist capabilities without intensive training of models with specialty knowledge.

arxiv-2403-16061.title: Nonstandard interactions of neutrinos with dense matter
arxiv-2403-16061.creator: Parada T. P. Hutauruk ID
arxiv-2403-16061.description: Abstract Nonstandard interaction is expected to be a crucial hint in explaining the experimental data on neutrino scattering off electrons. In this context, the nonstandard interaction vector and axial-vector couplings are needed to be extracted from recent experiments and a few of them are now available in the literature.

arxiv-2404-06001.title: Privacy Preserving Prompt Engineering: A Survey
arxiv-2404-06001.creator: Kennedy Edemacu, Xintao Wu
arxiv-2404-06001.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Kennedy Edemacu, Xintao Wu. Pre-trained language models (PLMs) have demonstrated significant proficiency in solving a wide range of general natural language processing (NLP) tasks. Researchers have observed a direct correlation between the performance of these models and their sizes. As a result, the sizes of these models have notably expanded in recent years, persuading researchers to adopt the term large language models (LLMs) to characterize the larger-sized PLMs.

arxiv-2409-11268.title: Elementary symmetric partitions
arxiv-2409-11268.creator: Cristina Ballantine
arxiv-2409-11268.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Cristina Ballantine. Let e k ​ ( x 1 , … , x ℓ ) e_{k}(x_{1},\ldots,x_{\ell}) be an elementary symmetric polynomial and let λ = ( λ 1 , … , λ ℓ ) \lambda=(\lambda_{1},\ldots,\lambda_{\ell}) be an integer partition. Define pre k ⁡ ( λ ) \pre_{k}(\lambda) to be the partition whose parts are the summands in the evaluation e k ​ ( λ 1 , … , λ ℓ ) e_{k}(\lambda_{1},\ldots,\lambda_{\ell}) .

arxiv-2510-08724.title: Counterfactually Fair Conformal Prediction
arxiv-2510-08724.creator: Ozgur Guldogan, Neeraj Sarna, Yuanyuan Li, Michael Berger
arxiv-2510-08724.description: Abstract While counterfactual fairness of point predictors is well studied, its extension to prediction sets —central to fair decision-making under uncertainty—remains underexplored. On the other hand, conformal prediction (CP) provides efficient, distribution-free, finite-sample valid prediction sets, yet does not ensure counterfactual fairness. We close this gap by developing Counterfactually Fair Conformal Prediction (CF-CP) that produces counterfactually fair prediction sets.

europmc-pmc8189436.title: Naive stem cell blastocyst model captures human embryo lineage segregation.
europmc-pmc8189436.creator: Yanagida A, Spindlow D, Nichols J, Dattani A, Smith A, Guo G.
europmc-pmc8189436.description: Human naive pluripotent cells can differentiate into extraembryonic trophectoderm and hypoblast. Here we describe a human embryo model (blastoid) generated by self-organization. Brief induction of trophectoderm leads to formation of blastocyst-like structures within 3 days....

pmc-10495438.title: Zanubrutinib: past, present, and future
pmc-10495438.creator: Constantine S. Tam, Javier L. Muñoz, John F. Seymour, Stephen Opat
pmc-10495438.description: In recent years, Bruton tyrosine kinase (BTK) inhibitors have provided significant advances in the treatment of patients with B-cell malignancies. Ibrutinib was the first BTK inhibitor to be approved, and it changed the standard-of-care treatment for diseases such as chronic lymphocytic leukemia, mantle cell lymphoma, marginal zone lymphoma, and Waldenström macroglobulinemia, improving efficacy outcomes and safety compared to chemotherapy.

pmc-10645671.title: Preoperative prediction of cholangiocyte phenotype hepatocellular carcinoma on contrast-enhanced MRI and the prognostic implication after hepatectomy
pmc-10645671.creator: Yidi Chen, Jie Chen, Chongtu Yang, Yuanan Wu, Hong Wei, Ting Duan, Zhen Zhang, Liling Long, Hanyu Jiang, Bin Song
pmc-10645671.description: BackgroundHepatocellular carcinoma (HCC) expressing cytokeratin (CK) 7 or CK19 has a cholangiocyte phenotype that stimulates HCC proliferation, metastasis, and sorafenib therapy resistance This study aims to noninvasively predict cholangiocyte phenotype-positive HCC and assess its prognosis after hepatectomy.MethodsBetween January 2010 and May 2022, preoperative contrast-enhanced MRI was performed on consecutive patients who underwent hepatectomy and had pathologically confirmed solitary HCC.

pmc-11364522.title: Successful Administration of Kampo Medicine and Acupuncture Treatment to Improve Erythromelalgia: A Case Report
pmc-11364522.creator: Keisuke Kumada, Jun Matsumoto-Miyazaki, Hideshi Okada, Hiroyuki Okura, Yasumasa Sato
pmc-11364522.description: Erythromelalgia is a rare disease characterized by a triad of recurrent burning pain, redness with pain, and hot flashes in the legs during attacks. We report the case of a 40-year-old woman who suffered from refractory erythromelalgia for 15 years and was successfully managed with Kampo medicine and acupuncture.

pmc-11558673.title: Exploring LCST- and UCST-like Behavior of Branched Molecules Bearing Repeat Units of Elastin-like Peptides as Side Components
pmc-11558673.creator: Naoki Tanaka, Keitaro Suyama, Keisuke Tomohara, Takeru Nose
pmc-11558673.description: Elastin-like peptides (ELPs) exhibit lower critical solution temperature (LCST)-type behavior, being soluble at low temperatures and insoluble at high temperatures. While the properties of linear, long-chain ELPs are well-studied, short-chain ELPs, especially those with branched architectures, have been less explored.

pmc-12642809.title: Quantifying and modeling loss of estrogen and progesterone in PDMS-based devices
pmc-12642809.creator: Nathaniel G. Hermann, Richard A. Ficek, Dmitry A. Markov, Lisa J. McCawley, M. Shane Hutson
pmc-12642809.description: An early study on the biological consequences of using polydimethysiloxane (PDMS) for microfluidic cell culture reported that estrogens could be sequestered by PDMS; however, the PDMS interaction parameters of specific hormones have not been reported. Without these parameters, it is not possible to assess whether such sequestration is a problem for a particular device and flow rate combination.

pmc-13146702.title: ABSTRACT NUMBER: ESOC2026A1122 DISTRIBUTION PATTERNS OF INTRACEREBRAL ATHEROSCLEROTIC PLAQUE ON HIGH-RESOLUTION MRI: ASSOCIATION WITH BALLOON ANGIOPLASTY OUTCOMES AND PROGNOSIS
pmc-13146702.creator: Shumeng Li, Gang Li
pmc-13146702.description: Background and aimsIntracranial atherosclerotic stenosis (ICAS) is one of the major causes of stroke worldwide, especially in Asia. The high-resolution MR vessel wall imaging (HR-MRI) could evaluate atherosclerotic plaque characteristics in ICAS patients. We aimed to explore the distribution of atherosclerotic plaque using HR-MRI and study its impact on balloon angioplasty and prognosis.

pmc-13482543.title: Sex-specific performance of composite metabolic-adiposity indices in identifying hypertension and carotid atherosclerosis: a cross-sectional study of 154,873 Chinese adults
pmc-13482543.creator: Xiaoqian Dong, Xue He, Yinglong Duan, Sha Wang, Xingxing Wang, Nandan Chen, Zitong Lu, Ying Li, Lijun Li, Honglian Zhang
pmc-13482543.description: The comparative superiority among the triglyceride-glucose (TyG) index and its obesity-related composite indicators in identifying hypertension and carotid atherosclerosis (CAS) remains unknown. This study aims to evaluate and compare the discriminative ability of these indices in a large-scale population to identify the optimal marker for cardiovascular risk assessment.
